info.text:
Nearly $50 billion on Synchrony cards, and fewer bills went unpaid.
Synchrony, the bank behind store cards like Amazon's and Lowe's, says purchases rose 8% in Q3 2026.
Its write-off rate fell to 4.79% from 5.16% a year earlier, and 30+ day late accounts held at 4.34% (4.39% a year ago).
Ally's auto loan losses were 1.89%, about flat with 1.88% a year ago.
Sources: Synchrony and Ally Q3 2026 results and earnings calls, Oct 20, 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
